abysslib.configuration.title: AbyssLib Configuration
abysslib.configuration.emissiveLayer.too: Draw an extra fullbright layer for block textures that have a matching texture with the suffix below (OptiFine style).
abysslib.configuration.emissiveSuffix.to: Suffix of the emissive overlay texture. OptiFine uses "_e". Empty disables the feature.
abysslib.configuration.emissiveExclude.t: Textures or namespaces that should not get an emissive overlay (prefix match, e.g. "minecraft:block/iron_ore" or "create:").
